narrative: 10 control alerts are open, of which 5 are critical and 1 are past their resolution SLA. 63 alerts were raised in the last 30 days, with a mean time to close of 3 hours.

6 of 12 continuous monitoring rules are currently passing or within tolerance. Rules in breach: CCM-001 Unverified onboarding; CCM-002 Unscreened high-value transaction; CCM-003 SAR overdue; CCM-010 Audit recommendation overdue; CCM-011 Unusual transaction volume; CCM-012 Control failed twice in a row.
The highest residual risk is R-004 "Privileged access sprawl" (residual 12/25, inherent 12/25). 2 open risks have no mapped controls.
7 of 14 regulatory obligations are assessed as compliant; non-compliant: Consumer Duty: outcomes monitoring. 3 regulatory return(s) fall due in the next 30 days.
Internal audit has 4 open findings, 1 overdue. 4 incident(s) were logged in the last 30 days, 2 rated high or critical.
